# Rule: repository-boundaries

Keep Markitect Core generic and independent of Modules, Host and CLI. Each capability Module depends only on Core and its own private implementation; never import sibling Modules or Host. Host composes Modules and supplies explicit normalized model/configuration/artifacts. CLI delegates to Host. The Go import gate mechanically enforces these directions. Keep Markitect Core independent of adopting repositories and model providers. Project artifacts remain opaque declared bytes; specialized checks/adapters own implementation-specific interpretation. Relationships and input scope are explicit, fixed-snapshot results are deterministic, unknown impact stays conservative, and generated projections have one canonical owner.

The accepted canonical projection reset makes the new Core a structural Schema/Kind/Property/Definition compiler. Engineering policies and execution live above it. Preserve validated projection-first contracts, normalized inputs, guarded lifecycle, immutable checks, accounting, provenance and drift/impact mechanics through deliberate migration; do not replace them merely because the foundation changes. Every installable Module is exactly a Schema Module or a Projection Module, never both. Schema Modules provide canonical language and may not depend on Projection Modules. Projection Modules provide target expertise and tools. Installation registers capabilities only. A canonical Projection explicitly binds semantic scope, desired representation type, target and selected representation policies; project configuration resolves the exact installed Projection Module; no automatic materialization follows installation. Host resolves a unique internal execution entrypoint. Users change canonical intent; Markitect derives affected reconciliation work. Concrete execution bindings remain configuration, not canonical ontology. All projections follow Executor, candidate and independent Verifier roles; deterministic renderers and checks are tools within that process, never a second authority model. Operational projection records and verification are separate from canonical intent.

Preserve strict check/verify acceptance, read-only failed-policy analysis, explicit exceptions and observe/plan/apply/verify trust boundaries. Desired, observed, inferred, candidate and generated state remain distinct. AI evidence is not owner acceptance. Follow the declared contribution checks; a source change does not update a published immutable release. The architecture and engineering-constitution documents retain technical contract ownership; this rule routes their exact bytes into development context.
